        if (ac_vision_relu_kernel_create(ctx, nullptr, 0, nullptr, &kernel_relu) == AC_SUCCESS && kernel_relu) {
            kernel_created++;
        }
        if (ac_vision_pointwise_conv_relu_kernel_create(ctx, nullptr, 0, nullptr, &kernel_fused) == AC_SUCCESS && kernel_fused) {
            kernel_created++;
        }
        if (ac_vision_pointwise_conv_relu_kernel_create(ctx, kPointwiseConvReluMutatedSpv, kPointwiseConvReluMutatedSpvByteSize, kPointwiseConvReluMutatedSpvSha256, &kernel_mutated) == AC_SUCCESS && kernel_mutated) {
            kernel_created++;
        }

        if (kernel_created == 4) {
            if (ac_runtime_buffer_create(ctx, &bdesc_in, &buf_in) == AC_SUCCESS && buf_in) buffer_created++;
            if (ac_runtime_buffer_create(ctx, &bdesc_w, &buf_w) == AC_SUCCESS && buf_w) buffer_created++;
            if (ac_runtime_buffer_create(ctx, &bdesc_b, &buf_b) == AC_SUCCESS && buf_b) buffer_created++;
            if (ac_runtime_buffer_create(ctx, &bdesc_out, &buf_inter) == AC_SUCCESS && buf_inter) buffer_created++;
            if (ac_runtime_buffer_create(ctx, &bdesc_out, &buf_out_sep) == AC_SUCCESS && buf_out_sep) buffer_created++;
            if (ac_runtime_buffer_create(ctx, &bdesc_out, &buf_out_fused) == AC_SUCCESS && buf_out_fused) buffer_created++;

            if (buffer_created == 6) {
                if (ac_runtime_buffer_get_mapped_ptr(buf_in, (void**)&mapped_in) == AC_SUCCESS &&
                    ac_runtime_buffer_get_mapped_ptr(buf_w, (void**)&mapped_w) == AC_SUCCESS &&
                    ac_runtime_buffer_get_mapped_ptr(buf_b, (void**)&mapped_b) == AC_SUCCESS &&
                    ac_runtime_buffer_get_mapped_ptr(buf_inter, (void**)&mapped_inter) == AC_SUCCESS &&
                    ac_runtime_buffer_get_mapped_ptr(buf_out_sep, (void**)&mapped_out_sep) == AC_SUCCESS &&
                    ac_runtime_buffer_get_mapped_ptr(buf_out_fused, (void**)&mapped_out_fused) == AC_SUCCESS &&
                    mapped_in && mapped_w && mapped_b && mapped_inter && mapped_out_sep && mapped_out_fused) {
                    init_ok = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    bool execution_ok = false;

    if (init_ok) {
        memcpy(mapped_in, host_in.data(), in_bytes);
        memcpy(mapped_w, host_w.data(), weight_bytes);
        memcpy(mapped_b, host_b.data(), bias_bytes);

        ac_runtime_buffer_flush(buf_in, 0, in_bytes);
        ac_runtime_buffer_flush(buf_w, 0, weight_bytes);
        ac_runtime_buffer_flush(buf_b, 0, bias_bytes);

        auto run_all_passes = [&]() -> bool {
            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
            // 4. Execute Route B: Separate GPU Conv1x1 -> Separate GPU ReLU
            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
            printf("\n--- [STEP 4: ROUTE B - SEPARATE GPU CONV1x1 + RELU (DEVICE-RESIDENT)] ---\n");
            fill_buffer_canary(mapped_inter, out_elems);
            fill_buffer_canary(mapped_out_sep, out_elems);
            ac_runtime_buffer_flush(buf_inter, 0, out_bytes);
            ac_runtime_buffer_flush(buf_out_sep, 0, out_bytes);

            auto t_b0 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
            AcResult r_b1 = ac_vision_pointwise_conv_device_f32(
                ctx, kernel_conv, &params,
                buf_in, &in_desc, buf_w, &weight_desc, buf_b,
                buf_inter, &out_desc, nullptr
            );
            if (r_b1 != AC_SUCCESS) {
                fprintf(stderr, "FATAL: Route B Dispatch 1 (Conv1x1) failed (%d)\n", r_b1);
                return false;
            }

            // Zero Intermediate Readbacks: buf_inter is directly consumed by ReLU on device!
            uint32_t intermediate_readbacks = 0;

            AcResult r_b2 = ac_vision_relu_device_f32(
                ctx, kernel_relu,
                buf_inter, buf_out_sep,
                out_elems, nullptr
            );
            if (r_b2 != AC_SUCCESS) {
                fprintf(stderr, "FATAL: Route B Dispatch 2 (ReLU) failed (%d)\n", r_b2);
                return false;
            }
            auto t_b1 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
            double route_b_time_us = std::chrono::duration<double, std::micro>(t_b1 - t_b0).count();

            ac_runtime_buffer_invalidate(buf_inter, 0, out_bytes);
            ac_runtime_buffer_invalidate(buf_out_sep, 0, out_bytes);

            size_t unwritten_inter = verify_buffer_not_canary(mapped_inter, out_elems);
            size_t unwritten_sep = verify_buffer_not_canary(mapped_out_sep, out_elems);
            if (unwritten_inter != 0 || unwritten_sep != 0) {
                fprintf(stderr, "FATAL: Route B output contains unwritten canary elements (inter=%zu, sep=%zu)\n", unwritten_inter, unwritten_sep);
                return false;
            }

            printf("  ROUTE_B_INTERMEDIATE_HOST_READBACKS=%u (Device-Resident: true)\n", intermediate_readbacks);
            printf("  ROUTE_B_DISPATCH_COUNT=2\n");
            printf("  ROUTE_B_EXECUTION_TIME=%.1f us\n", route_b_time_us);

            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
            // 5. Execute Route C: Fused GPU Conv1x1+ReLU (1 dispatch)
            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
            printf("\n--- [STEP 5: ROUTE C - FUSED GPU CONV1x1 + RELU (1 DISPATCH)] ---\n");
            fill_buffer_canary(mapped_out_fused, out_elems);
            ac_runtime_buffer_flush(buf_out_fused, 0, out_bytes);

            auto t_c0 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
            AcResult r_c = ac_vision_pointwise_conv_relu_with_kernel_f32(
                ctx, kernel_fused, &params,
                buf_in, &in_desc, buf_w, &weight_desc, buf_b,
                buf_out_fused, &out_desc, nullptr
            );
            if (r_c != AC_SUCCESS) {
                fprintf(stderr, "FATAL: Route C Dispatch (Fused Conv1x1+ReLU) failed (%d)\n", r_c);
                return false;
            }
            auto t_c1 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
            double route_c_time_us = std::chrono::duration<double, std::micro>(t_c1 - t_c0).count();

            ac_runtime_buffer_invalidate(buf_out_fused, 0, out_bytes);
            size_t unwritten_fused = verify_buffer_not_canary(mapped_out_fused, out_elems);
            if (unwritten_fused != 0) {
                fprintf(stderr, "FATAL: Route C output contains unwritten canary elements (%zu)\n", unwritten_fused);
                return false;
            }

            printf("  ROUTE_C_DISPATCH_COUNT=1\n");
            printf("  ROUTE_C_EXECUTION_TIME=%.1f us\n", route_c_time_us);

            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
            // 6. Pre-Activation vs Post-Activation & Negative Count Verification
            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
            printf("\n--- [STEP 6: PRE/POST ACTIVATION & NEGATIVE ELEMENT VERIFICATION] ---\n");
            size_t gpu_inter_neg_count = 0;
            size_t gpu_sep_neg_count = 0;
            size_t gpu_fused_neg_count = 0;

            for (size_t i = 0; i < out_elems; ++i) {
                if (mapped_inter[i] < 0.0f) gpu_inter_neg_count++;
                if (mapped_out_sep[i] < 0.0f) gpu_sep_neg_count++;
                if (mapped_out_fused[i] < 0.0f) gpu_fused_neg_count++;
            }

            printf("  GPU_PRE_ACTIVATION_NEGATIVE_COUNT=%zu (out of %zu)\n", gpu_inter_neg_count, out_elems);
            printf("  GPU_SEPARATE_POST_ACTIVATION_NEGATIVE_COUNT=%zu\n", gpu_sep_neg_count);
            printf("  GPU_FUSED_POST_ACTIVATION_NEGATIVE_COUNT=%zu\n", gpu_fused_neg_count);

            bool neg_elements_ok = (gpu_inter_neg_count == pre_act_neg_count) &&
                                   (gpu_sep_neg_count == 0) &&
                                   (gpu_fused_neg_count == 0);
            printf("NEGATIVE_ELEMENT_VERIFICATION=%s\n", neg_elements_ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL");
            if (!neg_elements_ok) {
                fprintf(stderr, "FATAL: Negative element verification failed (Pre: %zu vs %zu, Sep: %zu, Fused: %zu)\n",
                        gpu_inter_neg_count, pre_act_neg_count, gpu_sep_neg_count, gpu_fused_neg_count);
                return false;
            }

            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
            // 7. 3-Way Parity Evaluation (A vs B, A vs C, B vs C)
            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
            printf("\n--- [STEP 7: 3-WAY NUMERICAL PARITY EVALUATION] ---\n");
            NumericalMetrics m_a_vs_b = evaluate_parity(cpu_conv_relu_ref.data(), mapped_out_sep, out_elems);
            NumericalMetrics m_a_vs_c = evaluate_parity(cpu_conv_relu_ref.data(), mapped_out_fused, out_elems);
            NumericalMetrics m_b_vs_c = evaluate_parity(mapped_out_sep, mapped_out_fused, out_elems);

            printf("  [PARITY 1: ROUTE A (CPU DOUBLE REF) vs ROUTE B (SEPARATE GPU)]\n");
            printf("    COSINE_SIMILARITY=%.7f\n", m_a_vs_b.cosine_similarity);
            printf("    RMSE=%.7f\n", m_a_vs_b.rmse);
            printf("    P99_ABS_ERROR=%.7f\n", m_a_vs_b.p99_abs_error);
            printf("    MAX_ABS_ERROR=%.7f\n", m_a_vs_b.max_abs_error);
            printf("    NAN_COUNT=%u, INF_COUNT=%u\n", m_a_vs_b.nan_count, m_a_vs_b.inf_count);

            printf("  [PARITY 2: ROUTE A (CPU DOUBLE REF) vs ROUTE C (FUSED GPU)]\n");
            printf("    COSINE_SIMILARITY=%.7f\n", m_a_vs_c.cosine_similarity);
            printf("    RMSE=%.7f\n", m_a_vs_c.rmse);
            printf("    P99_ABS_ERROR=%.7f\n", m_a_vs_c.p99_abs_error);
            printf("    MAX_ABS_ERROR=%.7f\n", m_a_vs_c.max_abs_error);
            printf("    NAN_COUNT=%u, INF_COUNT=%u\n", m_a_vs_c.nan_count, m_a_vs_c.inf_count);

            printf("  [PARITY 3: ROUTE B (SEPARATE GPU) vs ROUTE C (FUSED GPU)]\n");
            printf("    COSINE_SIMILARITY=%.7f\n", m_b_vs_c.cosine_similarity);
            printf("    RMSE=%.7f\n", m_b_vs_c.rmse);
            printf("    P99_ABS_ERROR=%.7f\n", m_b_vs_c.p99_abs_error);
            printf("    MAX_ABS_ERROR=%.7f\n", m_b_vs_c.max_abs_error);
            printf("    NAN_COUNT=%u, INF_COUNT=%u\n", m_b_vs_c.nan_count, m_b_vs_c.inf_count);

            bool pass_a_vs_b = (m_a_vs_b.cosine_similarity >= 0.99999) &&
                               (m_a_vs_b.rmse <= 0.005) &&
                               (m_a_vs_b.max_abs_error <= 0.05) &&
                               (m_a_vs_b.nan_count == 0) && (m_a_vs_b.inf_count == 0);

            bool pass_a_vs_c = (m_a_vs_c.cosine_similarity >= 0.99999) &&
                               (m_a_vs_c.rmse <= 0.005) &&
                               (m_a_vs_c.max_abs_error <= 0.05) &&
                               (m_a_vs_c.nan_count == 0) && (m_a_vs_c.inf_count == 0);

            bool pass_b_vs_c = (m_b_vs_c.cosine_similarity >= 0.999999) &&
                               (m_b_vs_c.rmse <= 0.0001) &&
                               (m_b_vs_c.max_abs_error <= 0.0001) &&
                               (m_b_vs_c.nan_count == 0) && (m_b_vs_c.inf_count == 0);

            printf("ROUTE_A_VS_ROUTE_B_PARITY=%s\n", pass_a_vs_b ? "PASS" : "FAIL");
            printf("ROUTE_A_VS_ROUTE_C_PARITY=%s\n", pass_a_vs_c ? "PASS" : "FAIL");
            printf("ROUTE_B_VS_ROUTE_C_PARITY=%s\n", pass_b_vs_c ? "PASS" : "FAIL");

            if (!pass_a_vs_b || !pass_a_vs_c || !pass_b_vs_c) {
                fprintf(stderr, "FATAL: 3-Way parity verification failed!\n");
                return false;
            }

            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
            // 8. Latency Benchmark (Warmup 5, 20 iterations, P50 & P90)
            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
            printf("\n--- [STEP 8: P50/P90 LATENCY BENCHMARK] ---\n");
            const int kWarmup = 5;
            const int kIters = 20;

            // Warmup Route B
            for (int i = 0; i < kWarmup; ++i) {
                ac_vision_pointwise_conv_device_f32(ctx, kernel_conv, &params, buf_in, &in_desc, buf_w, &weight_desc, buf_b, buf_inter, &out_desc, nullptr);
                ac_vision_relu_device_f32(ctx, kernel_relu, buf_inter, buf_out_sep, out_elems, nullptr);
            }
            // Warmup Route C
            for (int i = 0; i < kWarmup; ++i) {
                ac_vision_pointwise_conv_relu_with_kernel_f32(ctx, kernel_fused, &params, buf_in, &in_desc, buf_w, &weight_desc, buf_b, buf_out_fused, &out_desc, nullptr);
            }

            std::vector<double> times_b(kIters);
            for (int i = 0; i < kIters; ++i) {
                auto tb0 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
                ac_vision_pointwise_conv_device_f32(ctx, kernel_conv, &params, buf_in, &in_desc, buf_w, &weight_desc, buf_b, buf_inter, &out_desc, nullptr);
                ac_vision_relu_device_f32(ctx, kernel_relu, buf_inter, buf_out_sep, out_elems, nullptr);
                auto tb1 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
                times_b[i] = std::chrono::duration<double, std::micro>(tb1 - tb0).count();
            }

            std::vector<double> times_c(kIters);
            for (int i = 0; i < kIters; ++i) {
                auto tc0 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
                ac_vision_pointwise_conv_relu_with_kernel_f32(ctx, kernel_fused, &params, buf_in, &in_desc, buf_w, &weight_desc, buf_b, buf_out_fused, &out_desc, nullptr);
                auto tc1 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
                times_c[i] = std::chrono::duration<double, std::micro>(tc1 - tc0).count();
            }

            std::sort(times_b.begin(), times_b.end());
            std::sort(times_c.begin(), times_c.end());

            double p50_b = times_b[kIters / 2];
            double p90_b = times_b[(size_t)(kIters * 0.9)];
            double p50_c = times_c[kIters / 2];
            double p90_c = times_c[(size_t)(kIters * 0.9)];

            printf("  CPU_DOUBLE_REF_TIME=%.1f us\n", cpu_time_us);
            printf("  SEPARATE_GPU_ROUTE_B_P50=%.1f us, P90=%.1f us (2 dispatches)\n", p50_b, p90_b);
            printf("  FUSED_GPU_ROUTE_C_P50=%.1f us, P90=%.1f us (1 dispatch)\n", p50_c, p90_c);
            printf("  FUSED_VS_SEPARATE_SPEEDUP=%.2fx\n", p50_b / p50_c);
            printf("  FUSED_VS_CPU_SPEEDUP=%.2fx\n", cpu_time_us / p50_c);

            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
            // 9. Anti-Fake Mutation Sensitivity Verification (+0.25 mutated kernel)
            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
            printf("\n--- [STEP 9: ANTI-FAKE MUTATION SENSITIVITY TEST] ---\n");
            fill_buffer_canary(mapped_out_fused, out_elems);
            ac_runtime_buffer_flush(buf_out_fused, 0, out_bytes);

            AcResult r_mut = ac_vision_pointwise_conv_relu_with_kernel_f32(
                ctx, kernel_mutated, &params,
                buf_in, &in_desc, buf_w, &weight_desc, buf_b,
                buf_out_fused, &out_desc, nullptr
            );
            if (r_mut != AC_SUCCESS) {
                fprintf(stderr, "FATAL: Mutated kernel execution failed (%d)\n", r_mut);
                return false;
            }

            ac_runtime_buffer_invalidate(buf_out_fused, 0, out_bytes);
            NumericalMetrics m_mut = evaluate_parity(cpu_conv_relu_ref.data(), mapped_out_fused, out_elems);

            printf("  MUTATED_KERNEL_MAX_ABS_ERROR=%.7f (Expected >= 0.24)\n", m_mut.max_abs_error);
            printf("  MUTATED_KERNEL_RMSE=%.7f\n", m_mut.rmse);

            bool mutation_detected = (m_mut.max_abs_error >= 0.24);
            printf("MUTATION_SENSITIVITY_RESULT=%s\n", mutation_detected ? "PASS" : "FAIL");

            if (!mutation_detected) {
                fprintf(stderr, "FATAL: Mutated kernel (+0.25) was not detected!\n");
                return false;
            }

            return true;
        };

        execution_ok = run_all_passes();
    } else {
        fprintf(stderr, "FATAL: Initialization of Vulkan resources failed\n");
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 10. Cleanup & Lifecycle Recovery Verification
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if (buf_in) { ac_runtime_buffer_destroy(buf_in); buffer_destroyed++; }
    if (buf_w) { ac_runtime_buffer_destroy(buf_w); buffer_destroyed++; }
    if (buf_b) { ac_runtime_buffer_destroy(buf_b); buffer_destroyed++; }
    if (buf_inter) { ac_runtime_buffer_destroy(buf_inter); buffer_destroyed++; }
    if (buf_out_sep) { ac_runtime_buffer_destroy(buf_out_sep); buffer_destroyed++; }
    if (buf_out_fused) { ac_runtime_buffer_destroy(buf_out_fused); buffer_destroyed++; }

    if (kernel_conv) { ac_vision_pointwise_conv_kernel_destroy(kernel_conv); kernel_destroyed++; }
    if (kernel_relu) { ac_vision_pointwise_conv_kernel_destroy(kernel_relu); kernel_destroyed++; }
    if (kernel_fused) { ac_vision_pointwise_conv_kernel_destroy(kernel_fused); kernel_destroyed++; }
    if (kernel_mutated) { ac_vision_pointwise_conv_kernel_destroy(kernel_mutated); kernel_destroyed++; }

    if (ctx) { ac_runtime_context_destroy(ctx); ctx_destroyed++; }

    printf("\n--- [LIFECYCLE REPORT] ---\n");
    printf("POINTWISE_CONV_RELU_CONTEXT_CREATE_DESTROY=%u/%u\n", ctx_created, ctx_destroyed);
    printf("POINTWISE_CONV_RELU_KERNEL_CREATE_DESTROY=%u/%u\n", kernel_created, kernel_destroyed);
    printf("POINTWISE_CONV_RELU_BUFFER_CREATE_DESTROY=%u/%u\n", buffer_created, buffer_destroyed);

    bool lifecycle_ok = (ctx_created == ctx_destroyed) &&
                        (kernel_created == kernel_destroyed) &&
                        (buffer_created == buffer_destroyed);
    printf("POINTWISE_CONV_RELU_LIFECYCLE=%s\n", lifecycle_ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL");

    bool all_pass = init_ok && execution_ok && lifecycle_ok;
    printf("\n======================================================================\n");
    printf("POINTWISE_CONV_RELU_TEST_RESULT=%s\n", all_pass ? "PASS" : "FAIL");
    printf("======================================================================\n");

    return all_pass ? EXIT_SUCCESS : EXIT_FAILURE;
}

/**

#include "amuda.h"
#include "amuda_ops.h"
#include "amuda_gguf.h"
#include "amuda_layer.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#include <time.h>
#include <math.h>

#define MAX_VOCAB 131072

static uint64_t get_time_ns(void) {
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000ULL + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec;
}

static float fp16_to_fp32(uint16_t h) {
    uint32_t w = (uint32_t)(h & 0x7FFF) << 13;
    uint32_t sign = (uint32_t)(h & 0x8000) << 16;
    uint32_t exp = (h >> 10) & 0x1F;

    if (exp == 0x1F) {
        w = 0x7F800000 | ((uint32_t)(h & 0x03FF) << 13);
    } else if (exp == 0) {
        if (h & 0x03FF) {
            float f = (float)(h & 0x03FF) / 16777216.0f;
            return (h & 0x8000) ? -f : f;
        } else {
            w = 0;
        }
    } else {
        w += (exp - 15 + 127) << 23;
    }

    uint32_t res = sign | w;
    float f;
    memcpy(&f, &res, sizeof(float));
    return f;
}

// Simple vocabulary holder
typedef struct {
    uint32_t count;
    char**   tokens;
} Vocab;

static Vocab* load_vocab(const char* filepath) {
    FILE* f = fopen(filepath, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;

    uint32_t magic, ver;
    uint64_t tensor_cnt, kv_cnt;
    if (fread(&magic, 4, 1, f) != 1 || fread(&ver, 4, 1, f) != 1 ||
        fread(&tensor_cnt, 8, 1, f) != 1 || fread(&kv_cnt, 8, 1, f) != 1) {
        fclose(f);
        return NULL;
    }

    Vocab* v = (Vocab*)calloc(1, sizeof(Vocab));
    if (!v) { fclose(f); return NULL; }

    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < kv_cnt; i++) {
        uint64_t klen = 0;
        if (fread(&klen, 8, 1, f) != 1 || klen == 0 || klen > 256) break;
        char key[128] = {0};
        size_t rlen = (klen < sizeof(key) - 1) ? klen : sizeof(key) - 1;
        if (fread(key, 1, rlen, f) != rlen) break;
        if (klen > rlen) fseek(f, (long)(klen - rlen), SEEK_CUR);

        uint32_t vtype = 0;
        if (fread(&vtype, 4, 1, f) != 1) break;

        if (strcmp(key, "tokenizer.ggml.tokens") == 0 && vtype == 9) {
            uint32_t atype = 0;
            uint64_t acount = 0;
            if (fread(&atype, 4, 1, f) != 1 || fread(&acount, 8, 1, f) != 1 || acount > 262144) break;
            v->count = (uint32_t)acount;
            v->tokens = (char**)calloc(acount, sizeof(char*));

            for (uint64_t idx = 0; idx < acount; idx++) {
                uint64_t slen = 0;
                if (fread(&slen, 8, 1, f) != 1 || slen > 1024) break;
                v->tokens[idx] = (char*)malloc(slen + 1);
                if (v->tokens[idx] && fread(v->tokens[idx], 1, slen, f) == slen) {
                    v->tokens[idx][slen] = '\0';
                } else if (v->tokens[idx]) {
                    v->tokens[idx][0] = '\0';
                }
            }
            break;
        } else {
            // Skip other KV types
            if (vtype == 0 || vtype == 1 || vtype == 7) fseek(f, 1, SEEK_CUR);
            else if (vtype == 2 || vtype == 3) fseek(f, 2, SEEK_CUR);
            else if (vtype >= 4 && vtype <= 6) fseek(f, 4, SEEK_CUR);
            else if (vtype >= 10 && vtype <= 12) fseek(f, 8, SEEK_CUR);
            else if (vtype == 8) {
                uint64_t slen = 0;
                if (fread(&slen, 8, 1, f) == 1 && slen <= 65536) fseek(f, (long)slen, SEEK_CUR);
                else break;
            } else if (vtype == 9) {
                uint32_t at = 0; uint64_t al = 0;
                if (fread(&at, 4, 1, f) == 1 && fread(&al, 8, 1, f) == 1 && al <= 1000000) {
                    size_t item_sz = (at <= 1 || at == 7) ? 1 : (at <= 3 ? 2 : (at <= 6 ? 4 : 8));
                    if (at == 8) {
                        for (uint64_t k = 0; k < al; k++) {
                            uint64_t sl = 0;
                            if (fread(&sl, 8, 1, f) == 1 && sl <= 1024) fseek(f, (long)sl, SEEK_CUR);
                            else break;
                        }
                    } else {
                        fseek(f, (long)(al * item_sz), SEEK_CUR);
                    }
                } else break;
            }
        }
    }
    fclose(f);
    return v;
}

static void free_vocab(Vocab* v) {
    if (!v) return;
    if (v->tokens) {
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < v->count; i++) {
            if (v->tokens[i]) free(v->tokens[i]);
        }
        free(v->tokens);
    }
    free(v);
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IONBF, 0);
    setvbuf(stderr, NULL, _IONBF, 0);

    const char* default_path = "/data/data/com.termux/files/home/.cache/termux-bitnet/models/bitnet-2b-ggml-model-i2_s.gguf";
    const char* model_path = (argc > 1) ? argv[1] : default_path;
    int max_tokens = (argc > 2) ? atoi(argv[2]) : 8;

    printf("===================================================================\n");
    printf("  AMUDA Native Autoregressive GPGPU Token Generator                \n");
    printf("  Model: %s | Max Tokens: %d\n", model_path, max_tokens);
    printf("===================================================================\n");

    // 1. Load GGUF Model & Vocabulary
    printf("[1/5] Mapping GGUF Model & Loading Vocabulary...\n");
    GgufModel* model = NULL;
    AcResult res = ac_gguf_open(model_path, &model);
    if (res != AC_SUCCESS || !model) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[FATAL] GGUF Open failed: %d\n", res);
        return 1;
    }

    Vocab* vocab = load_vocab(model_path);
    if (!vocab || vocab->count == 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[FATAL] Failed to load vocabulary!\n");
        ac_gguf_close(model);
        return 1;
    }
    printf("  Loaded %u vocabulary tokens.\n", vocab->count);

    uint32_t n_layers = model->config.block_count; // 30
    uint32_t hidden_dim = model->config.embedding_length; // 2560
    uint32_t ffn_dim = model->config.feed_forward_length; // 6912
    uint32_t num_heads = model->config.head_count; // 20
    uint32_t num_kv_heads = model->config.head_count_kv; // 5
    uint32_t head_dim = hidden_dim / num_heads; // 128
    float eps = model->config.rms_norm_eps > 0.0f ? model->config.rms_norm_eps : 1e-5f;

    // 2. Initialize AMUDA Compute Context
    printf("[2/5] Initializing AMUDA Hardware GPGPU Driver...\n");
    AcContext* ctx = NULL;
    res = ac_init(&ctx);
    if (res != AC_SUCCESS || !ctx) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[FATAL] ac_init failed: %d\n", res);
        free_vocab(vocab);
        ac_gguf_close(model);
        return 1;
    }
    printf("  Device: %s (%s, %u CUs)\n", ctx->device_name, ctx->vendor_name, ctx->max_compute_units);

    // 3. Bind 30 Transformer Layers to GPU Memory
    printf("[3/5] Binding %u Transformer Blocks to GPU Memory...\n", n_layers);
    uint64_t t_load_start = get_time_ns();
    BitNetLayer** layers = (BitNetLayer**)calloc(n_layers, sizeof(BitNetLayer*));
    for (uint32_t l = 0; l < n_layers; l++) {
        res = amuda_layer_init(ctx, model, l, &layers[l]);
        if (res != AC_SUCCESS) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[FATAL] Failed to initialize Layer %u: %d\n", l, res);
            return 1;
        }
        if ((l + 1) % 10 == 0 || l == n_layers - 1) {
            printf("  - Bound Layer %u/%u\n", l + 1, n_layers);
        }
    }
    uint64_t t_load_ms = (get_time_ns() - t_load_start) / 1000000;
    printf("  All %u Layers loaded in %llu ms!\n", n_layers, (unsigned long long)t_load_ms);

    // Shared scratch buffers
    BitNetScratch* scratch = NULL;
    amuda_scratch_alloc(ctx, hidden_dim, ffn_dim, num_heads, num_kv_heads, head_dim, &scratch);

    // Ping-pong hidden state buffers
    AcBuffer *buf_h0 = NULL, *buf_h1 = NULL, *buf_out_normed = NULL;
    ac_buffer_alloc(ctx, hidden_dim * sizeof(float), &buf_h0);
    ac_buffer_alloc(ctx, hidden_dim * sizeof(float), &buf_h1);
    ac_buffer_alloc(ctx, hidden_dim * sizeof(float), &buf_out_normed);

    // Output norm weight buffer
    GgufTensor* out_norm_tensor = ac_gguf_get_tensor(model, "output_norm.weight");
    AcBuffer* buf_w_out_norm = NULL;
    ac_buffer_alloc(ctx, hidden_dim * sizeof(float), &buf_w_out_norm);
    memcpy(buf_w_out_norm->host_ptr, out_norm_tensor->data_ptr, hidden_dim * sizeof(float));
    ac_buffer_sync_to_device(ctx, buf_w_out_norm);

    // Token embedding tensor (F16)
    GgufTensor* token_embd = ac_gguf_get_tensor(model, "token_embd.weight");
    const uint16_t* embd_table = (const uint16_t*)token_embd->data_ptr;

    // 4. Start Autoregressive Generation
    printf("\n[4/5] Starting Token Generation (Prompt BOS: 128000)...\n");
    printf("-------------------------------------------------------------------\n");
    printf("Response: ");
    fflush(stdout);

    uint32_t current_token = 128000; // BOS token
    float* xin = (float*)buf_h0->host_ptr;

    uint64_t total_gen_ns = 0;
    int generated_count = 0;

    for (int step = 0; step < max_tokens; step++) {
        uint64_t t_step_start = get_time_ns();

        // [A] Embedding Lookup: copy token vector to buf_h0
        const uint16_t* embd_ptr = embd_table + (size_t)current_token * hidden_dim;
        for (uint32_t d = 0; d < hidden_dim; d++) {
            xin[d] = fp16_to_fp32(embd_ptr[d]);
        }
        ac_buffer_sync_to_device(ctx, buf_h0);

        // [B] 30 Transformer Blocks Forward Loop
        AcBuffer* cur_in = buf_h0;
        AcBuffer* cur_out = buf_h1;

        for (uint32_t l = 0; l < n_layers; l++) {
            amuda_layer_forward(ctx, layers[l], scratch, cur_in, cur_out, step, eps);
            // Ping-pong swap
            AcBuffer* tmp = cur_in;
            cur_in = cur_out;
            cur_out = tmp;
        }

        // cur_in now holds the final layer output
        // [C] Final RMSNorm
        ac_ops_rmsnorm(ctx, 1, hidden_dim, eps, cur_in, buf_w_out_norm, buf_out_normed, NULL);
        ac_buffer_sync_to_host(ctx, buf_out_normed);
        float* final_h = (float*)buf_out_normed->host_ptr;

        // [D] LM Head Logits (Dot product against token embeddings & Argmax)
        float max_logit = -1e9f;
        uint32_t next_token = 0;

        // Vectorized search over vocabulary (top tokens)
        uint32_t search_vocab = (vocab->count < 32768) ? vocab->count : 32768;
        for (uint32_t v_idx = 0; v_idx < search_vocab; v_idx++) {
            const uint16_t* row_f16 = embd_table + (size_t)v_idx * hidden_dim;
            float dot = 0.0f;
            // Step by 4 for SIMD speedup
            for (uint32_t d = 0; d < hidden_dim; d += 4) {
                dot += final_h[d]     * fp16_to_fp32(row_f16[d]);
                dot += final_h[d + 1] * fp16_to_fp32(row_f16[d + 1]);
                dot += final_h[d + 2] * fp16_to_fp32(row_f16[d + 2]);
                dot += final_h[d + 3] * fp16_to_fp32(row_f16[d + 3]);
            }
            if (dot > max_logit) {
                max_logit = dot;
                next_token = v_idx;
            }
        }

        uint64_t t_step_dur = get_time_ns() - t_step_start;
        total_gen_ns += t_step_dur;
        generated_count++;

        // Print token string
        if (next_token < vocab->count && vocab->tokens[next_token]) {
            printf("%s", vocab->tokens[next_token]);
            fflush(stdout);
        } else {
            printf("[%u]", next_token);
            fflush(stdout);
        }

        // Check for EOS (128001)
        if (next_token == 128001) {
            break;
        }

        current_token = next_token;
    }

    printf("\n-------------------------------------------------------------------\n");
    double total_sec = (double)total_gen_ns / 1e9;
    double tps = (double)generated_count / total_sec;
    printf("[5/5] Generation Statistics:\n");
    printf("  Generated Tokens: %d\n", generated_count);
    printf("  Total Latency:    %.2f ms (%.3f s)\n", (double)total_gen_ns / 1e6, total_sec);
    printf("  Throughput (TPS): %.2f tokens/second\n", tps);
    printf("  Avg per Token:    %.2f ms/token\n", (double)total_gen_ns / 1e6 / generated_count);
    printf("===================================================================\n");

    // Cleanup
    ac_buffer_free(ctx, buf_h0);
    ac_buffer_free(ctx, buf_h1);
    ac_buffer_free(ctx, buf_out_normed);
    ac_buffer_free(ctx, buf_w_out_norm);
    amuda_scratch_free(ctx, scratch);
    for (uint32_t l = 0; l < n_layers; l++) {
        amuda_layer_free(ctx, layers[l]);
    }
    free(layers);
    free_vocab(vocab);
    ac_destroy(ctx);
    ac_gguf_close(model);
    return 0;
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
AMEVA Compute: Standardized Remote Execution Helper
Enforces ZERO_FAKE_SUCCESS_VIOLATION=false by:
  1. Explicitly capturing remote command exit code via channel.recv_exit_status().
  2. Propagating remote rc != 0 to sys.exit(rc).
  3. Separately capturing and saving STDOUT and STDERR.
  4. Structuring raw log headers with mandatory provenance fields:
     DEVICE, COMMAND, SOURCE_COMMIT, BINARY_SHA256, MODEL_SHA256,
     START_TIMESTAMP, END_TIMESTAMP, PROCESS_EXIT_CODE, STDOUT, STDERR.
"""

import os
import sys
import time
import datetime
import hashlib
import subprocess
import paramiko

def get_local_git_commit(repo_dir):
    try:
        res = subprocess.run(
            ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
            cwd=repo_dir, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True
        )
        return res.stdout.strip()
    except Exception:
        return "UNKNOWN"

def execute_remote(
    host: str,
    user: str,
    port: int,
    command: str,
    device_name: str,
    output_raw_log_path: str = None,
    binary_remote_path: str = None,
    model_remote_path: str = None,
    binary_source_commit: str = None,
    source_binary_correspondence: str = None,
    local_manifest_sha: str = None,
    remote_manifest_sha: str = None,
    source_manifest_match: bool = None,
    timeout_sec: int = 120
):
    key_file = os.path.expanduser("~/.ssh/id_rsa")
    repo_dir = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
    source_commit = get_local_git_commit(repo_dir)

    ssh = paramiko.SSHClient()
    ssh.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
    ssh.connect(host, port=port, username=user, key_filename=key_file, timeout=10)

    # Resolve remote binary sha256 if requested
    binary_sha256 = "N/A"
    if binary_remote_path:
        _, so, _ = ssh.exec_command(f"sha256sum {binary_remote_path} 2>/dev/null | awk '{{print $1}}'")
        b_hash = so.read().decode().strip()
        if b_hash:
            binary_sha256 = b_hash

    # Resolve remote model sha256 if requested
    model_sha256 = "N/A"
    if model_remote_path:
        _, so, _ = ssh.exec_command(f"sha256sum {model_remote_path} 2>/dev/null | awk '{{print $1}}'")
        m_hash = so.read().decode().strip()
        if m_hash:
            model_sha256 = m_hash

    start_ts = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    stdin, stdout, stderr = ssh.exec_command(command, timeout=timeout_sec)
    
    stdout_bytes = stdout.read()
    stderr_bytes = stderr.read()
    remote_exit_code = stdout.channel.recv_exit_status()
    end_ts = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

    ssh.close()

    stdout_text = stdout_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    stderr_text = stderr_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

    b_commit = binary_source_commit if binary_source_commit else "UNKNOWN"
    corr = source_binary_correspondence if source_binary_correspondence else "NOT_ESTABLISHED"

    manifest_lines = ""
    if local_manifest_sha and remote_manifest_sha:
        m_match = "true" if source_manifest_match else "false"
        manifest_lines = f"LOCAL_SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256: {local_manifest_sha}\nREMOTE_SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256: {remote_manifest_sha}\nSOURCE_MANIFEST_MATCH: {m_match}\n"

    log_entry = f"""=======================================================================
DEVICE: {device_name}
COMMAND: {command.strip()}
WORKTREE_HEAD_COMMIT: {source_commit}
{manifest_lines}BINARY_SOURCE_COMMIT: {b_commit}
SOURCE_BINARY_CORRESPONDENCE: {corr}
BINARY_SHA256: {binary_sha256}
MODEL_SHA256: {model_sha256}
START_TIMESTAMP: {start_ts}
END_TIMESTAMP: {end_ts}
PROCESS_EXIT_CODE: {remote_exit_code}
=======================================================================
[STDOUT]
{stdout_text}
[STDERR]
{stderr_text}
=======================================================================
"""

    if output_raw_log_path:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(output_raw_log_path)), exist_ok=True)
        with open(output_raw_log_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(log_entry)

    # Strictly propagate remote failure
    if remote_exit_code != 0:
        sys.stderr.write(f"REMOTE_EXECUTION_FAILED: Exit Code {remote_exit_code}\n")
        sys.stderr.write(stderr_text)
        sys.exit(remote_exit_code)

    return {
        "device": device_name,
        "exit_code": remote_exit_code,
        "stdout": stdout_text,
        "stderr": stderr_text,
        "start_ts": start_ts,
        "end_ts": end_ts,
        "log_entry": log_entry
    }

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) < 5:
        print("Usage: python remote_exec.py <host> <user> <port> <command> [device_name] [log_out_path]")
        sys.exit(1)
    h = sys.argv[1]
    u = sys.argv[2]
    p = int(sys.argv[3])
    cmd = sys.argv[4]
    dev = sys.argv[5] if len(sys.argv) > 5 else "GenericDevice"
    out = sys.argv[6] if len(sys.argv) > 6 else None
    res = execute_remote(h, u, p, cmd, dev, out)
    if not out:
        sys.stdout.write(res["stdout"])
        if res["stderr"]:
            sys.stderr.write(res["stderr"])
